title: FAA to audit India's aviation safety oversight standards from Nov 16-20
description:
The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) will conduct an audit of India's aviation safety oversight standards, mainly covering the areas of aircraft operations, airworthiness and personnel licensing, from November 16 to 20.
Currently, India, one of the world's fastest growing civil aviation markets, has Category 1 status under FAA's aviation safety assessment programme.
FAA under its International Aviation Safety Assessment (IASA) programme determines whether a country's oversight of its air carriers that operate, or seek to operate, into the US or codeshare with a US air carrier, complies with safety standards established by the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO).
The official said the FAA team will be carrying out the audit from November 16-20 that will cover mainly the areas of aircraft operations, airworthiness and personnel licensing.
